privacySection.title: Your data is safe with us
privacySection.intro: Users share their CVs and personal information with us, and we handle them with the highest level of care and responsibility.
privacySection.point1Desc: We use your data only to prepare your applications and never for any other purpose.
privacySection.point2Desc: We do not sell or share your data with advertisers or third parties.
privacySection.point3Desc: You can request full deletion of your files and profile at any time in one message.
privacySection.point4Desc: Files are protected with transport encryption and secure storage to safeguard your privacy.

about.title: About us
about.story: We are a small team of builders who believe applying for a good job shouldn't be complicated or expensive. We built Shaghalni to stand beside you at every step, from polishing your CV to preparing for the interview.
about.mission: “Help every job seeker go after their chance with confidence.”
about.teamSubtitle: Passionate about making job applications accessible and straightforward

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Shaghalni and how it works
faq.a1: You can start now for free. We will clarify plans and options here at official launch.
faq.q2: Do I need to download an app?
faq.a2: No, Shaghalni works entirely inside WhatsApp and Telegram, apps you already use.
faq.a3: Shaghalni fully supports both Arabic and English for chat and document preparation.
faq.q4: Does Shaghalni guarantee me a job?
faq.a4: No one can guarantee employment. Shaghalni helps you submit stronger, faster applications; the final decision is the employer's.
faq.q5: Is my data and CV secure?
faq.a5: Yes, your data is encrypted and protected, and never sold to third parties. Check our privacy page for more details.
faq.q6: Does Shaghalni apply on my behalf?
faq.a6: Shaghalni prepares the tailored files and messages, and you review them yourself before sending.
faq.q7: What job fields and types are supported?
faq.a7: Shaghalni supports most professional, technical, administrative, and service roles across experience levels.
faq.q8: How do I contact the team?
faq.a8: You can reach us through our contact page, via email, or directly inside the chat.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.draftNotice: Note: This is a draft subject to legal review before official launch.
privacyPage.sec1Content: We only collect information necessary to provide the service: the CV you share, job descriptions or links you submit, and your chat history with the assistant.
privacyPage.sec2Content: We use your data solely to tailor your CV, draft relevant cover letters, and provide interview advice for specific job opportunities.
privacyPage.sec3Content: We retain your files and chat records only as long as needed to provide the service, or until you request deletion.
privacyPage.sec4Content: We never sell or rent your personal data to third parties, nor do we use it for unauthorized advertising.
privacyPage.sec5Content: You have the right to request a copy of your data or its permanent deletion at any time by contacting us.
privacyPage.sec6Content: We implement rigorous security standards including transport encryption and protected storage.
privacyPage.sec7Content: For any privacy-related inquiries, please contact our team via the designated privacy email.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.draftNotice: Note: This is a draft subject to legal review before official launch.
termsPage.sec1Content: Shaghalni is an AI assistive tool for preparing application materials (CVs and cover letters). Shaghalni does not guarantee employment and is not an employment agency.
termsPage.sec2Content: Users are solely responsible for the accuracy of information in their application documents and for reviewing materials before submission.
termsPage.sec3Content: Using the service to generate fraudulent or misleading documents or attempting to exploit the system is strictly prohibited.
termsPage.sec4Content: The service is provided 'as is'. We are not liable for employment decisions or outcomes resulting from applications.
